overall: One continuous read of the whole passage in one take. Read it as a person who knows this subject and is explaining what AEP Texas's own page says and what it does not publish. Dry and plain. Not a news anchor, not a documentary hush, not a bright explainer lilt. Energy moves in drops as well as lifts: the opening is brisk and curious, the mechanism is quicker, the limits are the lowest and most certain part, and the close is level and falling. Carry every sentence join without a reset. Say AEP as three separate letters, A, E and P, each clear and even, every time it appears. Say AI as two letters, A and I. Give room only at the turn and at the close, and only as a normal breath at a full stop, never as a held silence. Keep one steady, brisk conversational pace from the first word to the last, about the speed of a person reading aloud to a colleague, and do not slow down at the limit lines or the close. The total read should run about forty to forty three seconds. Take a short clear breath of about a third of a second at exactly two commas, after the words are up in the second sentence and after the word smoke in the third sentence, so that each clause lands on its own. Everywhere else keep running on.
performance_arc: Clear and curious over the sweep, plain on the count, quicker through the flag and the message, level on the estimate, then slower and plain on the limits and the close.

lines.text: A camera on a tall tower in west Texas watches the land all the way around.
lines.intent: Open on the camera watching the land. A curious hook: the viewer is handed the sweep first, then the tower that holds it.
lines.energy: Opening lift, the most forward energy of the piece so far, direct and curious rather than dramatic. Carry it straight through the sentence and let it come down only at the join into the count.
lines.pause_after: Full stop with a normal breath, then carry straight into the next line with no reset in pitch.
lines.reason: The sweep at s1-event-1 is the picture of watches the land all the way around, and the pull back to the tower at s1-event-2 gives the subject a name. The lift is the hook, and the fall is saved for the count.

lines.text: AEP Texas says sixteen of these AI cameras are up, with fifty six planned by February.
lines.intent: State the count as AEP's own figure, the way a reporter reads a number from a company release. Keep fifty six as one number with no break inside it.
lines.energy: Level and plain, one step below the opening lift, a steady informative run with no added enthusiasm. The AEP Texas attribution stays flat so the figure reads as the company's own.
lines.pause_after: No break at the comma after up. Connected run into with fifty six planned by February, then a normal full stop.
lines.reason: The lit rings at s2-event-1 match sixteen and the outlined planned rings at s2-event-2 match fifty six. The source's as of early October date is not spoken and not pictured, see flag F9.

lines.text: When one sees heat or smoke, the software sends a text or an email to the AEP Texas team.
lines.intent: Explain the mechanism in order: the camera sees, the software sends, the team receives. Say one as the pronoun for one camera, unstressed, and let the team be the receiver.
lines.emphasis: sends a text or an email
lines.energy: Quicker and forward, a clear step above the count because this is the action. Keep it crisp and even through the flag and the message, with no lift on the team.
lines.pause_after: A light comma breath after smoke with no hold, carrying straight into the software. Normal full stop after team.
lines.reason: The plume and flag at s3-event-1 match heat or smoke, the card leaving the display at s3-event-2 matches the software sends, and the phone buzzing at s3-event-3 matches the team receiving it. The comma is a cut boundary, not a place to stop the voice.

lines.text: AEP estimates that message lands within ten minutes of detection.
lines.intent: Give the ten minutes as AEP's estimate and not as a measured time. The word estimates carries the limit, and the number is said flat.
lines.energy: Level and measured, a little below the mechanism, with no speed claim on the number. Keep the middle pitch through the sentence and let the fall land on detection.
lines.pause_after: Normal full stop, then the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: The clock window at s4-event-1 and the estimated tag at s4-event-2 show the same qualifier the voice carries. The clock shows an estimate, not a measured time, and the voice says so in the same breath.

lines.text: The cameras don't stop fires. AEP says they give it awareness it can share with first responders.
lines.intent: Turn from the sweep to the limit. Negate stopping fires as a plain firm statement, then give AEP's own claim of awareness it can share, keeping it can share together as one unit.
lines.energy: The turn, firmer than the estimate before it on the negation but not higher in pitch, a level firm stop. The second sentence returns to the plain register of the source.
lines.pause_after: Full stop after fires with a normal breath, then the second sentence follows at once. The edit carries the room at this turn, and the voice does not hold.
lines.reason: The plume keeps burning under the locked flag box at s5-event-1 while the voice negates stopping it. The dashed line stops short at s5-event-2 while the voice says the awareness can be shared, so the open line shows what can happen, not a share that failed. See flag F12.

lines.text: The utility's wildfire lead says no major fire has needed an AEP Texas response since launch.
lines.intent: Report the wildfire lead's own statement about response, with the qualifier major spoken. The sentence opens on The utility's, the same phrase that opens the final line, so AEP stays the subject.
lines.energy: Plain and level, a little below the limit sentence before it. No lift on no, because this is a report from a named source and not a result to celebrate.
lines.pause_after: Normal full stop after launch, and the join from the previous line into Its carries no reset.
lines.reason: The calendar band from launch to now at s6-event-1 and the wildfire lead tag at s6-event-2 carry the attribution. The picture shows no red mark, which pictures more than the source says, so the spoken word major has to do the qualifying. See flag F11.

lines.text: AEP publishes no record of how much sooner anyone arrives.
lines.intent: Give the most important limit: AEP publishes no record of how much sooner anyone arrives. Plain, certain and quiet, the lowest point of the film.
lines.energy: The lowest and slowest line of the piece, certain and level, with the least pitch movement of the whole read. The quietest delivery belongs to the most important limit, so keep it low through the last word.
lines.pause_after: No hold inside the line. Full stop at the end, then the next line joins with no reset of pitch.
lines.reason: The blank response record at s7-event-1 and the how much sooner field that pulses once and stays empty at s7-event-2 are the picture of the missing record. The voice names the absence while the empty field is on screen.

lines.text: The utility's wildfire plan still waits on state approval.
lines.intent: End on the status of the utility's plan, which is still open. The word still carries the unresolved state, and the close is stated flat, not as an outcome.
lines.energy: Level and low, a settled falling close with approval as the lowest and final word. No upturn at the end and no triumph about a plan that has not yet been approved.
lines.pause_after: Full stop at the close, then the take ends. No tail and no added hold.
lines.reason: The plan folder reaches the commission desk with its approval slot open at s8-event-1, and the closing composite keeps the open slot, the sweep and the open line at s8-event-2. The close answers what is still open without implying approval.
